items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Mat Domber is very loose about studio time and he doesn’t want the music to be forced. And he’s very fair in that respect.

ctx.x: Now on a session like this, I would imagine budget-wise you’re fairly tight with the studio time? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
That one wasn’t. Actually Arbors doesn’t do that to musicians. Mat Domber is very loose about studio time and he doesn’t want the music to be forced. And he’s very fair in that respect.
So you get in there and do a run through and then—
